# Draft (create mode)

**Title:** Export a report as CSV and email it to the requester

## Context

Requesters can view reports in the widgets app, but they cannot get a CSV copy of a report.

## Problem

A requester cannot export the report they are viewing, and cannot have that export emailed to them. For example, a requester looking at a report's rows has no way to take those rows away as a file, either by download or by email.

## Idea

The reporter proposes an Export CSV button in acme/widgets, with acme/mailer delivering the exported file.

## Acceptance Criteria

### acme/widgets

- [ ] Given a requester has a report open, when the report finishes loading, an **Export CSV** button is shown on the report.
- [ ] Given a report displaying a known set of rows, when the requester clicks **Export CSV**, the resulting CSV contains exactly those displayed rows, with the columns `name` and `count`.

### acme/mailer

- [ ] Given a requester has exported a report as CSV and asked for email delivery, when the request is submitted, an email arrives at the requester's address with that same CSV attached.

---

# AC integrity gate (assembled draft)

**Normalization:** the three required outcomes were extracted from prose and rendered as `- [ ]` items. ACs are grouped by repo because the Idea names two repos. This is attribution inside one ticket, not a split.

| AC | Class | Setup / action / observable | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|
| widgets: button shown | Behavioral | report open / load / button visible | **Pass** |
| widgets: export contents | Behavioral; set is enumerable today (the rows the report displays) | known displayed rows / click Export CSV / CSV rows and columns `name`, `count` match | **Pass** |
| mailer: emailed attachment | Behavioral | exported CSV plus email request / submit / email with that CSV at requester's address | **Pass** |

- No wishful, tautological, unspecified-but-binding, or external-input ACs were found, so there is no hard stop and no park.
- Deploy window: every AC can be verified before production. Nothing is relocated, so no Post-deployment housekeeping section is needed.

# Other inline gates

- **Split detection:** none proposed. This is one end-to-end deliverable and the user did not request a split.
- **Displaced-detail check:** no closed-list matches. The Idea is one attributed sketch line, and Context and Problem contain no implementer inventories.
- **Reporter note comment:** none proposed. There is no overflow and no in-session ask.
- **Evidence gate:** the ticket asserts a missing UI capability, which counts as user-visible behavior. Evidence: `none (requested new capability; no screenshot supplied)`. You can attach a screenshot of the current report view, without the export control, at the confirmation gate if you want one.
- **Metadata:** there are no tracker fields to preserve. Labels and type will be proposed at the confirmation gate, along with the title and body.

**Next:** roast (step 7), then the confirmation gate (step 8).

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.text:
## Title
Export report CSVs and email them to requesters

## Context
Requesters can view reports in the widgets app but cannot receive a CSV copy.

## Problem
A requester cannot export the report they are viewing or have its CSV emailed to their address.

Example: none (no specific report or reproduction artifact was supplied).

## Idea
The reporter proposes an Export CSV button in acme/widgets, with acme/mailer sending the exported file when the requester asks for email delivery.

## Acceptance Criteria

### acme/widgets
- [ ] Given a report available to the requester, opening that report displays an Export CSV button.
- [ ] Given an open report, clicking Export CSV produces a CSV containing the displayed rows with the columns `name` and `count`.

### acme/mailer
- [ ] Given a CSV exported from the displayed report and the requester's email address, requesting email delivery results in the requester receiving an email at that address with that CSV attached.

---

**AC integrity gate: Pass.** Each criterion names a setup, action, and observable result that can be verified before production deployment. No baseline, external yardstick, or production-only observation is required.

**Evidence:** Requester-supplied description; no screenshots or reproduction artifacts supplied.

One end-to-end ticket; no split or comment proposed.
